I have steadfastly (“nera”) believed (“nammithi”) and prayed to you (“ninnu”) daily (“nityamugA”). O lotus-eyed (“niraja nayana”) one, your form (“AkarA”) is of incomparable (“nir-upama”) beauty (“sundara”). Anupallavi: You are the father (“kanna”) of Cupid (“Maaruni”). The goddess Sri lives (“nivasa”) in you.
